Name: Weapon Moveset
Description: Registers a new weapon attack category (aCCC_03XXXX) for the attack selectors (WeaponCategoryRight, WeaponCategoryHandStyle, WeaponCategoryLeft) in c0000.hkx. With a reference category (an existing weapon type), each new clip copies the reference's clip (looping jump loops, variable bindings), and the Reference Category source copies every attack that weapon type has. Based on HkbEditor's weapon_moveset template (ndahn/HkbEditor).

Groups.Name: Right hand
Groups.Description: One-handed attacks: light combo, heavies, running, rolling, backstep, guard counter.

Groups.Name: Jump attacks
Groups.Description: Jump attacks (NewJump StateMachine), right, both and dual. Use a reference so the jump loops copy its looping clips.

Groups.Name: Jump swing variations
Groups.Description: The jump attacks' landing swing variations.

Notes: Set the weapon's EquipParamWeapon Weapon Motion Category (wepmotionCategory) to {Category}.
Add the a{Category}_ animations to c0000's anibnd, with their time acts.
